rows.note: Use this as the broad, all-purpose adjective for something that gives pleasure, especially in a polished description.

example.english: This collaboration gave everyone a pleasurable experience.
example.traditional: 呢次合作為大家帶來一次愉快嘅經驗。
example.jyutping: nei1 ci3 hap6 zok3 wai4 daai6 gaa1 daai3 loi4 jat1 ci3 jyu6 faai3 ge3 ging1 jim6

rows.note: Choose this for bodily comfort or sensory pleasure, such as a pleasurable massage or relaxing experience.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 on3 mo1 zan1 hai6 hou2 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Choose this when the pleasurable thing mainly makes someone feel happy or is enjoyable as an activity.

example.english: Shopping with friends is really pleasurable.
example.traditional: 同朋友一齊行街真係好開心。
example.jyutping: tung4 pang4 jau5 jat1 cai4 haang4 gaai1 zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1
